basic_details.scholarship_name: University of Edinburgh Edinburgh Global Research Scholarship
basic_details.offering_entity: University of Edinburgh (Scholarships and Student Funding Services)
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: University of Edinburgh (Old College, King's Buildings, and Edinburgh BioQuarter)
basic_details.major_restrictions: Full-time doctoral research across all academic disciplines, with high concentration in Informatics, Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Medicine, and Physical Sciences.
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~30 prestigious Edinburgh Global Research Scholarships awarded annually across all colleges
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Open globally to all overseas fee-status doctoral applicants; typically 2 to 4 Pakistani researchers awarded per year
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: 36 months (3 full years of doctoral funding)

nationality_requirements: International fee-status applicants from all countries worldwide including Pakistan
eligibility_requirements.age_limit_notes: No statutory age limit under University of Edinburgh regulations.
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: Recognized 18-year Master's degree (MS / MPhil) or high First Class 16-year Bachelor's degree from an HEC-recognized institution with minimum CGPA 3.60 / 4.00 (80%+).
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Minimum CGPA 3.60 / 4.00 or UK First Class Honours equivalent; competitive candidates typically hold CGPA >= 3.80 / 4.00.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Must have applied for admission to a full-time PhD programme at the University of Edinburgh and received an active student UUN before the scholarship deadline.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Master's graduate or final-year master's student with verified academic research record.
eligibility_requirements.graduation_year_restrictions: No restriction on year of graduation.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Prior research experience, journal publications, or conference presentations substantially improve competitive standing.
eligibility_requirements.language_notes: IELTS Academic minimum 7.0 (no band below 6.5) or TOEFL iBT minimum 100 (no section below 22). MOI certificates are not accepted.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Merit-based competition evaluating academic excellence and research potential.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Cannot hold another full UK Research Council or Commonwealth award simultaneously.

tuition_fee.details: Covers the difference between the tuition fee for a UK/home student and that chargeable to an overseas student, plus full College home fee waiver, ensuring 100% tuition coverage.

admission_application_fee.details: Applying for PhD research degrees at Edinburgh is free of charge.

accommodation.details: Funded directly from the monthly living stipend; University Accommodation Services assists with university postgraduate apartments.

monthly_stipend.details: GBP 1,600 / month living stipend (~PKR 595,000 / month | ~GBP 19,237 / year matching UKRI doctoral rates).

airfare.details: International travel between Pakistan and Edinburgh is self-funded.

visa_fee.details: UK Student Visa fee (~GBP 490) and Immigration Health Surcharge (~GBP 776/year) covered by candidate or research group top-up.
visa_fee.amount: UK Visa & IHS fees borne by candidate

health_insurance.details: Full access to the UK National Health Service (NHS) for the duration of the doctoral studies.

food_allowance.details: Covered via monthly GBP 1,600 living stipend plus access to campus cafeterias across Central and King's Buildings campuses.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Full digital and archival access to University of Edinburgh Main Library and Alan Turing Institute partner networks.
books_and_materials_allowance.amount: Full university and Turing Institute access

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Research Training Support Grant (RTSG) provided by host school for laboratory consumables and conference travel.

travel_transit_allowance.details: Subsidized Lothian bus student ridacard across Edinburgh transit network.

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Single host university (University of Edinburgh, Edinburgh, Scotland, UK).
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: World top 30 university (QS World University Rankings); #1 in the UK for computing and informatics research power (REF 2021).
available_majors: PhD in Data Science & Machine Learning
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: Master's degree (CGPA >= 3.60 / 4.00), prior agreement with prospective Edinburgh doctoral supervisor, comprehensive research proposal, CV, two academic references, and IELTS 7.0+.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: Must apply for PhD admission by mid-December to obtain a University Username (UUN) before applying for the scholarship by January 22.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Align research proposal with Edinburgh's flagship research centers (School of Informatics, Bayes Centre, or Usher Institute).

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: MyEd Applicant Portal & EUCLID Admissions System
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Step 1: Contact potential supervisor and submit PhD application via EUCLID. Step 2: Receive 8-digit University User Number (UUN) and MyEd login. Step 3: Access the Scholarship and Funding section in MyEd and complete the Edinburgh Global Research Scholarship online form before January 22.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1: Identify and secure informal support from a prospective PhD supervisor at Edinburgh.
Step 2: Submit a formal application for admission to a PhD research programme via the University of Edinburgh Degree Finder by early January.
Step 3: Receive EUCLID login details and MyEd account access.
Step 4: Navigate to the 'Scholarship and Funding' channel within MyEd.
Step 5: Complete and submit the Edinburgh Global Research Scholarship application form before January 22, 23:59 GMT.
Step 6: School Selection Panels rank eligible applicants and nominate candidates to the Central College Committee.
Step 7: College Selection Committees review nominations in February and March.
Step 8: Final scholarship decisions announced via email in mid-April.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Separate Routing: Candidates must first submit a PhD programme application, obtain a UUN, and then apply separately for the scholarship via the MyEd portal.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Submitted as part of the formal PhD application via EUCLID referee upload link.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Structured statement within the scholarship application explaining research novelty, scholarly background, and why Edinburgh is the ideal research environment.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Detailed research proposal (maximum 1,500 to 2,000 words) outlining objectives, state-of-the-art, methodology, and 3-year research plan.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Academic CV detailing qualifications, publications, awards, and technical expertise.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: Departmental interview conducted by prospective supervisor and second assessor to evaluate doctoral aptitude.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: IELTS Academic 7.0+ (min 6.5 each) or TOEFL iBT 100+ (min 22 each).
application_process_roadmap.application_fee_amount: GBP 0 (Free to apply for PhD admission and scholarship)
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: HEC degree attestation required for Pakistani applicants.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Certified English translation for all official records.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: Online submission via MyEd Student Portal.

required_documents_checklist.specification: HEC-attested degrees with First Class / Distinction (minimum CGPA 3.60 / 4.00).
Complete transcripts showing all courses, grades, and grading scheme.
Structured research proposal (1,500-2,000 words) with bibliography and timeline.
Letter of endorsement from prospective Edinburgh academic supervisor.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Obtained directly from Edinburgh faculty member.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Academic CV highlighting publications, projects, and research skills.
Confidential referee appraisals submitted directly to EUCLID.
Official IELTS (min 7.0) or TOEFL iBT (min 100) certificate.

important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: January 22 (23:59 GMT) is the strict scholarship deadline; admission application must be submitted at least 2 weeks earlier to generate UUN.

selection_process_and_weights.academic_weight: 40% (Undergraduate and postgraduate academic record, class rank, and honors)
selection_process_and_weights.extracurricular_and_leadership_weight: 5% (Academic service, peer mentorship, or scientific outreach)
selection_process_and_weights.research_experience_weight: 35% (Quality, originality, and feasibility of research proposal, publication record)
selection_process_and_weights.personal_statement_weight: 10% (Clarity of motivation and strategic fit with Edinburgh research groups)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: College Postgraduate Studies Committees and Central University Scholarships Selection Committee.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Two-tier review: departmental ranking of candidates followed by college-wide competitive panel assessment.

competitiveness_profile.total_annual_applicants: ~1,000 to 1,500 doctoral applicants applying across colleges
competitiveness_profile.acceptance_rate_pakistan: ~3% to 4% among shortlisted candidates with master's degrees and publications
competitiveness_profile.typical_successful_applicant_gpa: 3.85 / 4.00 (First Class with Distinction and first-author publications)
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Scholars in informatics, AI, biomedical data, or physics with high citations, top conference papers, and supervisor backing.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Graduates from NUST, LUMS, GIKI, Quaid-i-Azam University, and FAST-NUCES.
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: United Kingdom, Pakistan, India, China, Italy, United States, Canada, Nigeria.

fake_websites_and_scams: Only apply through official University of Edinburgh portal https://www.ed.ac.uk/ and MyEd.
Beware of fraudulent agents charging fees for admission or scholarship sponsorship.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: Applying for PhD admission and the Edinburgh Global Research Scholarship is completely free.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: University of Edinburgh does not collaborate with education consultants for postgraduate research scholarships.
hidden_costs_breakdown: Flight from Pakistan to Edinburgh: ~PKR 160,000 to 230,000.
misleading_claims_debunked: Myth: You can apply for the scholarship on the deadline day without applying for admission. Reality: You cannot access the MyEd scholarship form without an existing PhD application submitted well in advance.
Myth: The scholarship covers only tuition fees. Reality: The award combines tuition fee coverage with full UKRI-rate living stipends (GBP 1,600/month).
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Unofficial blogs suggest supervisor contact is optional; Edinburgh faculty explicitly state that unendorsed proposals are virtually never funded.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Successful annual review and progression through formal doctoral milestone reviews.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Full-time research commitment on campus at the University of Edinburgh.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Annual progress reviews conducted by the School Postgraduate Research Board.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Scholars may undertake demonstrator or tutorial teaching duties up to 6 hours per week with supervisor approval.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: None; zero service bond or return obligation.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Termination of funding if doctoral candidate fails annual review or discontinues studies without cause.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Topic adjustments within the agreed project area permitted with supervisor approval.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Strictly limited to 36 months (3 years) of funding.
